descriptions.notStarted: Gaga, who' now a secret agent, says he has someone he wants to introduce me to. I wonder who it is?
descriptions.inProgress: Gaga, who suddenly became a secret agent of an unknown organization, has deputized me and now I am an agent as well. Gaga suggested I do a co-op with special agent O.
descriptions.completed: Through Gaga's introduction, I met Special Agent O. He seemed like quite a character--full of personality and life.
